recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the CDS work group explicitly decides to rename or replace the existing content-type search parameter.
issue_request: FHIR-19255 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Library change request asking for a contentType search parameter so clients can retrieve libraries by the content type of attached library content; its resolution specified a token search parameter over content.contentType.
initial_application: Commit e620428bb1 applied the Jira request by adding a content-type token search parameter with expression Library.content.contentType to the former Library spreadsheet source. The 33b409a4b6 source refactor moved that application into the current bundled Library search-parameter source.
additional_context: Library is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/library/bundle-Library-search-params.xml currently defines SearchParameter Library-content-type with code content-type, type token, and expression Library.content.contentType. The rendered CI build exposes the same parameter. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision to remove or rename it. FHIR-19256 is an adjacent Library content-summary tracker already represented on the combined branch and does not affect this search parameter.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. No source change was made because the requested search parameter is already present and changing the historically applied content-type code to camel-case contentType would be an unsupported incompatible rename.
